summary: Geersing Potato Specialist is a Dutch company in Emmeloord that develops potato varieties and sells their seed potatoes, with a focus on late-blight resistant varieties and organic farming. It grew out of a family breeding programme whose first crosses were made in 2003, and became a B.V. in 2019 under Jan-Eric Geersing.
ownership: Led by Jan-Eric Geersing; full shareholding not published
products: Late-blight resistant varieties for organic cultivation
markets: Most varieties marked as suitable for export
facts: First crosses in the breeding programme made in 2003
Holds a 20% stake in Caithness Potatoes Holding B.V., set up in 2011
Breeding trials on an organic farm in Nagele plus four satellite test fields in the Netherlands
Ten varieties listed in the variety catalogue
limitations: Turnover, staff numbers, seed hectares, tonnages, certification classes and export countries are not published on the pages read.
The variety pages do not say who bred or owns each variety.
